epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce 'done' tasks with conflicting PR states from >40 findings to 0 findings
epics.tocConstraintRef: Inaccurate internal state blocking PM task tracking
requirements: R1: The system must patch existing code to reconcile internal task status with actual GitHub PR states when discrepancies are found

slices.title: Patch CI status reconciliation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status reconciliation patch for this epic, I want to update task states to match GitHub PR states, so that the PM's operational reality is accurate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task marked 'done' internally, When its actual GitHub PR state is not merged or completed, Then the system updates the internal state to match the PR.
Given the system updates the internal task state, When persisting the change, Then it must use an atomically-guarded update (e.g., UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND status = ?) rather than a read-then-save.
Given the patch is implemented, When the automated tests run, Then unit and integration tests must verify the state reconciliation logic.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of tasks with state discrepancies from >40 to 0
